material.acceptance_criteria: a CI run with the test-only override exits non-zero and prints a FAIL browser load line; the normal run stays green.
material.description: The perf step's over-ceiling failure path (exit non-zero when load exceeds the ceiling) has only been exercised through the zero-ceiling self-check, which never exits the step. Run the step once with a ceiling the real load exceeds (a named test-only override the job sets), and assert the step exits non-zero and prints the FAIL line.
material.resolution: The perf step's failure path is witnessed in CI: with BROWSER_LOAD_CEILING_OVERRIDE_MS=1 on the witness step only, the step prints browser over-ceiling witnessed load=475 ceiling=1 exit=1 and fails when the check passes. The normal perf step still uses the stored ceiling.
material.subject: Witness the browser perf step failing on a real over-ceiling load
